adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (e.g. `{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed `data` itself. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff changes from `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` (which returns the credential object) to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then writes `data: { key }` to Prisma. That would persist the SafeParse wrapper instead of the credential shape expected elsewhere (previously validated by `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)`), breaking later reads/parses of `credential.key`. This is directly verifiable from the shown code.
